profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ CoreWeave
profile.summary:
I am a solutions-driven software engineer with a passion for helping customers streamline their operations through building easy to use APIs and efficient services. 

Before transitioning to engineering, I worked primarily in advertising and marketing, which has provided me with a results-driven mentality. I am accustomed to and greatly enjoy working with many different stakeholders both on the business and technical side.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Hybrid

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
At The New York Times, I worked across Platform Enablement and Subscriptions Growth teams, where I:
	•	Modernized CI/CD pipelines and deployment environments across the commerce platform org (Drone CI, Terraform, Bash).
	•	Led a large-scale migration of an EC2 fleet, coordinating planning, rollout, and operational readiness.
	•	Designed and drove major platform upgrades, including Java 11 → Java 21 and Spring Boot 2 → 3.

On the Subscriptions Growth team, I built and operated a low-latency, highly scalable GraphQL service serving read-only subscription data at thousands of requests per second, and led the design of an event-driven caching layer with strong Datadog-based observability.

I also built integrations that enabled NYT Digital Subscriptions through multiple third-party partners, and led the end-to-end authentication design and implementation for the partner-facing experience. Delivered systems in both Java and Go.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
• Developed and maintained the Python software development kit, boto3, enhancing backend interactions with AWS services.  
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration of interfaces for various applications.  
• Implemented best practices in software development to improve code quality and maintainability.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed new features and enhanced existing code for a leading e-commerce analytics platform.  
• Collaborated within an agile scrum team, utilizing Python with Django and Django REST frameworks, as well as GoLang.  
• Built data pipeline and warehouse solutions using Airflow, Spark, AWS Athena, and RDS (MySQL).  
• Containerized services with Docker and managed deployments via Jenkins.

positions.title: Data Engineer
positions.description: Created first fully automated batch data pipeline that extracts information from an on-premise ecommerce application’s MSSQL database to the company’s analytics hub in GCP’s Cloud Storage and Bigquery. Configured and set up a devoted Airflow server for the same ecommerce application to orchestrate, schedule and execute various data jobs. Built streaming pipeline from payment processor (Stripe) to GCP using message bus (Pub/Sub) and event-listening script in Kubernetes. Integrate various 3rd party data sources through RESTful APIs into GCP. Orchestrate, configure and deploy all Airflow jobs in containerized Python scripts on a Kubernetes cluster.
